description: Implement RFC 9670 (JMAP Sharing) extension trait over jmap-base-client. JmapSharingExt adds 10 typed methods: principal_get, principal_changes, principal_set, principal_query, principal_query_changes, share_notification_get, share_notification_changes, share_notification_set (takes &[Id], destroy-only), share_notification_query, share_notification_query_changes. Spec: RFC 9670. Pattern: follow jmap-chat-client (per-method modules, wiremock tests). Blocked by: jmap-sharing-types epic.
title: jmap-sharing-client: RFC 9670 client methods
